text_en: My child, keep my words and store up my commandments with you;
text_cn: 我儿，你要持守我的训言，把我的诫命藏在心中；

text_en: keep my commandments and live, keep my teachings as the apple of your eye;
text_cn: 你要遵守我的诫命，好叫你得以生存；应恪守我的教训，像保护你眼中的瞳人；

text_en: bind them on your fingers, write them on the tablet of your heart.
text_cn: 应将我的诫命系在指间，刻在心上；

text_en: Say to wisdom, “You are my sister, ” and call insight your intimate friend,
text_cn: 应对智慧说：“你是我的姊妹，”并应称睿智为你的女友，

text_en: that they may keep you from the loose woman, from the adulteress with her smooth words.
text_cn: 好能保护你远避奸妇，即那甜言蜜语的淫妇。

text_en: For at the window of my house I looked out through my lattice,
text_cn: 我曾由我家的窗口，透过窗格往外观看，

text_en: and I saw among the simple ones, I observed among the youths, a young man without sense,
text_cn: 分明看见在愚昧人中，在少年人中，有一个无知的少年，

text_en: passing along the street near her corner, taking the road to her house
text_cn: 沿着淫妇屋角的街道经过，向她的住宅走去，

text_en: in the twilight, in the evening, at the time of night and darkness.
text_cn: 那时正是黄昏，日已西沉，已入黝黑深夜。

text_en: Then a woman comes toward him, decked out like a prostitute, wily of heart.
text_cn: 看，有一个女人向他迎面而来——她身穿妓装，存心不轨；

text_en: She is loud and wayward; her feet do not stay at home;
text_cn: 她健谈好荡，不能停留家中：

text_en: now in the street, now in the squares, and at every corner she lies in wait.
text_cn: 一会在街头，一会在市场，在每个角落上兜搭——

text_en: She seizes him and kisses him, and with impudent face she says to him:
text_cn: 她遂上前拥抱那少年，与他接吻，嬉皮笑脸对他说：

text_en: “I had to offer sacrifices, and today I have paid my vows;
text_cn: “我原许过愿，要献和平祭，今日才得偿还我许的愿。

text_en: so now I have come out to meet you, to seek you eagerly, and I have found you!
text_cn: 所以我走了出来，好能与你相遇；我急切寻找你，可好现在我见了你。

text_en: I have decked my couch with coverings, colored spreads of Egyptian linen;
text_cn: 我的床榻已舖设了绒毯，放上了埃及的线绣卧单；

text_en: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
text_cn: 又用没药、芦荟和肉桂薰了我的睡床。

text_en: Come, let us take our fill of love until morning; let us delight ourselves with love.
text_cn: 来让我们通宵达旦，饱享爱情；让我们在欢爱中尽情取乐，

text_en: For my husband is not at home; he has gone on a long journey.
text_cn: 因为我的丈夫现不在家，他已出外远行，

text_en: He took a bag of money with him; he will not come home until full moon. ”
text_cn: 随身带了钱囊，不到月圆不归家。”

text_en: With much seductive speech she persuades him; with her smooth talk she compels him.
text_cn: 淫妇用许多花言巧语笼络他，以谄言媚语勾引他。

text_en: Right away he follows her, and goes like an ox to the slaughter, or bounds like a stag toward the trap
text_cn: 少年遂跟她去了，好像一只引入屠场的公牛，又像一只自陷圈套的牡鹿，

text_en: until an arrow pierces its entrails. He is like a bird rushing into a snare, not knowing that it will cost him his life.
text_cn: 直至箭矢射穿他的心肝；他还像一只跳入罗网的小鸟，不知这与他的性命有关。

text_en: And now, my children, listen to me, and be attentive to the words of my mouth.
text_cn: 现在，孩子！你们应听从我，留意我口中的训言：

text_en: Do not let your hearts turn aside to her ways; do not stray into her paths.
text_cn: 不要让你的心倾向她的道路，不要误入她的迷途，

text_en: For many are those she has laid low, and numerous are her victims.
text_cn: 因为她使许多人倒地身亡，连最强健的，都作了她的牺牲。

text_en: Her house is the way to Sheol, going down to the chambers of death.
text_cn: 她的家是通往阴府的大道，是引入死境的斜坡。
